description: The shop's PostgreSQL database, read through a SELECT-only user. Off by default: rename this folder to shopdb to turn it on (see the guide, 'Same investigation, with a real database').

url.description: Connection URL of the read-only database user

paymentsFor.description: The payments and the webhook events of one order: did the provider take the money, and did the shop handle the confirmation? Read-only.

paidButUnconfirmed.description: Orders whose payment was captured by the provider but that are still awaiting_payment: customers who paid and have no order, with the money involved. Read-only.

since.description: Only payments captured at or after this time, ISO 8601
